The '''Nightsister speeder''', sometimes called the '''Ubrikkian speeder''' due to its manufacturer [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]] was used by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was used by former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to take [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to the [[Nightsister fortress]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The Ubrikkian speeder bike was a high-powered speeder able to carry a pilot and a passenger with high speed. The speeder possessed a jagged, [[Ablative plating/Legends|ablative]] armor provides protection from the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts. While the speeder had lack of armament, it's sharp prongs can be used to decimate foes by riding through enemy lines.<ref name="TCWUK6.37" />

The speeder bike was also difficult to fly because the lighter sidecar threw off the balance of heavy turbojet.<ref name="TCWUK6.37" />
